title: Neural Architect Portfolio
tagline: Cinematic Cyberpunk Portfolio with GSAP & Three.js
description: A high-fidelity developer portfolio built with Next.js 16, featuring a multi-theme design system, custom GSAP animations, and Three.js background systems. Designed to mimic a military-grade neural interface.

overview.problem: Generic portfolios fail to capture the complexity and aesthetic depth of advanced agentic development. The goal was to build an 'experience' that feels like a real-time operating system.

process.description: Designing the 'Neural Architect' brand identity and cinematic UI metaphors.
Implementing the multi-layer background system and theme engine.
Crafting the BootSequence and page transitions using GSAP ScrollTrigger.
Optimizing WebGL performance and ensuring binary-level responsiveness.

title: CodeForge AI
description: An advanced AI operative that lives in your repository, analyzing tech stacks and generating production-hardened deployment configurations automatically. It bridges the gap between local development and cloud-scale production.

overview.problem: Small teams struggle to maintain consistent, hardened DevOps practices while moving fast. Manual configuration of Docker, CI/CD, and Monitoring is error-prone and time-consuming.

process.description: Implementing the repository scanning engine using LangChain and custom AST parsers.
Curating hardened Docker and Terraform modules for various tech stacks.

title: Track Financially
description: A sophisticated finance management platform that uses AI to categorize transactions and provide real-time investment insights. Integrated with bank APIs for seamless tracking.

title: Developer Tool Suite
description: A comprehensive toolkit for developers, featuring everything from code formatters to network analyzers, all in one cinematic interface. Designed for rapid-fire troubleshooting and optimization.

title: Portfolio Terminal CLI
tagline: Full-stack terminal emulator for portfolio interaction.
description: A dedicated interactive terminal that allows users to interact with my portfolio using custom CLI commands. Built with a custom command registry system.

overview.problem: Users often find traditional navbars boring. I wanted to provide a 'power user' way to explore my work.

process.description: Built a custom regex-based parser for terminal inputs.
Authentic CRT-glow effect and font implementation.
